text:
Type: small illustrated kids rug
Use: a soft spot by a bed or door; children's room, playroom, entryway
Style: contemporary, retro
Materials: short soft low pile, bound edge
Colors: black, bright pink, white
Shape: small rectangle drawn like a house front, pink door and window below, tall white windows above, flat, compact
Feel: playful, quirky, cheerful
Goes with: white walls, pink or black accents, light wood; playful kids' rooms and playrooms

product.name: HEMMAHOS
product.description: If you combine many rugs you can create a colourful street with its own zebra crossing.
